title: SageMaker AI across the ML lifecycle
description: Pick the SageMaker AI feature for each stage of building, deploying, monitoring and documenting a model.

cards.prompt: Clean and transform the returns data for a model with little or no code, inside SageMaker.
Let a business analyst build a demand-forecasting model without writing any code.
Have human workers label 50,000 product photos by category to create training data.
cards.why: Ground Truth labels training data before a model exists. A2I sends a live model's low-confidence predictions to people.

cards.prompt: Store customer features once so the training job and the live fraud model read the same values.
Rerun data preparation, training, evaluation and registration as one repeatable workflow every week.
Keep track of each version of the churn model and whether it has been approved for production.
cards.why: The Model Registry tracks versions and approval status. Model Cards document what a model is for and how it was evaluated.

cards.prompt: Get an alert when the data reaching the deployed fraud model starts to drift from its training data.
Check whether the credit-approval training data under-represents some age groups before training.
Explain which features pushed the fraud model to flag one particular order.
Record the fraud model's intended use, training data, evaluation results and risk rating for auditors.
Send the product-image classifier's low-confidence predictions to a person for review.
Train and deploy Cairnway's own churn model with full control over the algorithm and the endpoint.
Start from a pre-trained open-weight model and fine-tune it in SageMaker on Cairnway's data.
Watch a deployed model for changes in how much each feature drives its predictions (feature-attribution drift).
